description: A user-defined grouping of a team's assets, billed on the team's one consolidated invoice but broken out on it line by line (ARCHITECTURE.md §2.1). An optional spending limit caps the project's own committed monthly run-rate: once at the limit, no further asset may be tagged into it. The team always remains the biller/payer.

fields.label: Spending Limit
fields.description: Cap on this project's own committed monthly run-rate (the summed locked_rate of its tagged subscriptions) — in the team's billing currency. 0 or unset = no limit. Once at the limit, tagging another asset into this project is refused; assets already in it keep running untouched.

name: Project
